result.title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
result.summary: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent. These recipes, however, treat the searchable world as fixed: a new question can be well formed and verifiable while its evidence is absent from the retrieval backend, so the agent issues the right query, retrieves nothing, and is penalized as if its policy were at fault. Such unreachable negatives accumulate with every round of growth. We propose Search-RSI, a recursive self improvement framework that expands the search world along the agent's capability frontier. In each round, the current policy diagnoses its partially mastered regions of a task space spanned by hop depth, relation rarity, and distractor density; new tasks there are grown together with their evidence; and the same policy decides how they are used: candidates on which its probes disagree feed reinforcement learning, while those beyond its reach become hint guided demonstrations of its own. Keeping the policy inside this loop matters: an improver frozen at the start of training loses 3.2 points. On nine multimodal search benchmarks, Search-RSI keeps improving where static task growth saturates, raising the average accuracy of the recipe it builds on by 9.8 and 9.5 points at 9B and 27B, of which 7.0 points are out of reach for a world that is merely made consistent. The loop uses no external model and only privileged task structure that is removed before training, at 1.27x the compute of static growth.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Search-RSI，一个递归自进化训练框架：每轮由当前多模态搜索 agent 诊断自己在跳数深度、关系稀有度与干扰密度所张成任务空间中的「部分掌握」区域，同步生长新任务与其证据，并由同一策略决定其用途——探测分歧的样本用于强化学习，超出能力的样本转为提示引导示范。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据不存在却被当作策略失败惩罚」的问题刻画了证据可得性与策略贡献混淆，与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、贡献分配和监督设计直接相关；但论文围绕外部检索世界扩展与训练课程，未涉及内部 latent 推理状态，THINK/LOOK 计算与停止决策的对应关系需读原文核查。
